rules.statement: A person who has no legal title can still sue for use and occupation if there is a relationship of landlord and tenant between the plaintiff and defendant.
rules.supporting_quote: "I see no reason why a person in the occupation of land to which he has not a complete title should not sue for use and occupation a person, ... Foot Notes: 1 (1841) 1 Q. B. 850. 2 (1864) Ram. 1863-48,83. 202 whom he has put into occupation under himself."
